description: Analyze one image and attach the result to an existing case. Spends credits (D1 1, D2 2, D3 10) exactly like geolocate_image. Capped at 20 analyses an hour across all Oceanir analysis tools, and a connected app is limited to depth 2. Returns the analysis and the case id. Reads the scene only (architecture, signage, terrain, vegetation), never the people in it. No face recognition, no biometric identification, no person matching. It answers where an image was taken, never who is in it, and must not be used to locate or track a person.

case_id.description: A case id from list_cases or create_case.

depth.description: Analysis depth. 1 = Surface (1 credit). 2 = Standard (2 credits). 3 = Forensic (10 credits; agent tokens with maximum depth 3 only).

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to the image to analyze.

name: analyze_case_image
title: Analyze an image into a case
